pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches exhibit irregular, sub-circular to polygonal geometries with soft, diffused edge gradients. Individual dark regions vary in size, showing higher fragmentation and smaller relative spatial area on the posterior hindquarters compared to the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pelage forms the interstitial space. Junction nodes are wide and multi-directional, with pathways maintaining a relatively thick and consistent pixel width throughout the visible flank area.
